d: The movie story deals with Priyanka a teenager who lives a very wealthy lifestyle with her widowed politician father, Satyendra Pal Choudhary. Satyendra owes his allegiance to Bharatiya Ekta Party. As Satyendra's popularity rises he fears for his life and that of his daughter's and as a result hires a bodyguard named Ajay for Priyanka. Gradually, Priyanka and Ajay fall in love with each other. With the elections approaching, and Satyendra's growing popularity creates some uncertainty with other political parties; as a result Priyanka is kidnapped and Ajay is seriously wounded while trying…
